description.text: Teaching Objective The program is committed to train students to become applied engineering and technical talented professionals with a sound theoretic foundation, systematical knowledge and skill of the capability to carry out the scientific research, system analysis, system design, technical development, and management in the field of computer science and technology and capability of engineering practice in computer software and hardware development and application in science research departments, education institution, enterprises, technical and administrative departments.Duration4 academic yearsDegree Awarded Bachelor of Engineering

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Wuhan University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
